init.title: Device Settings

data.use_history: Import history (Type 17) to HA external statistics

init.description: All data is transmitted locally over MQTT. If set to 0, realtime mode is disabled and the monitor sends data at its base interval (every 15 minutes by default). Setting a value greater than 0 (e.g., 2–60) sets the update interval in seconds (sends {"type": "12", "up_itvl": "...", "duration": "3600"} to the down topic). Changes take effect within 0 to 15 minutes (on the monitor's next communication cycle).
